title: Generation Z in France, Spain and Albania is trapped: study hard, stay poor, live with your parents. No wonder they’re protesting
lede: From under-resourced schools in France to Spain’s housing crisis and student protests in Albania, the immediate grievances differ. Yet they raise a common question: can young people turn education into secure work and an independent life?

title: PM Babiš blames press for ANO election loss, renews calls to abolish license fees for Czech public media
lede: Andrej Babiš vows no policy retreat after ANO's election flop. With the opposition gaining ground in a weekend senate vote in Czech Republic, the prime minister has moved to scrap public media license fees.
